title: Good value.
content: Good price on both camera and cloud service. However, the picture quality is questionable. It seems like the compression level is too high. Things that don't move are sharp and clear but people that pass by are often scrambled so it's hard to identify who they are no matter if it's viewed thru the cloud or from the SD-card.

title: Great Value for Money Camera
content: Pros - *Good picture quality given the price *Small, good-looking camera *Easy to use and reliable app *Incredible night vision *Can be used outside *Can add a memory card for local recording and storage Cons - *Doesn't work reliably with Chromecast *No web browser support (so viewing is limited to the app, unless you employ a workaround) *Need to pay for subscription to get meaningful and reliable notifications (and cloud recording is limited to identified events only) However, given the price, the cons listed above are certainly not unexpected, nor are they deal-breakers. Would still highly recommend this camera for the vast majority of use cases.

title: incredible images
content: For the price, this is an excellent little camera. The only and I mean "only" issue i have is the zoom function. The images are pixelated when you zoom on an image. So if you need to identify a person or license plate, the i.age needs to be within 10 to 15 feet. The camera will detect vehicles out on our road, which is over 300 feet but useless for zooming in on that image. The cars and trucks are very discernible but no other details about the vehicle is. Overall for the price, I like the camera, I will buy more.
